about: Canonical format of every raw row the tool writes. Python (itb/rawformat.py) validates rows against this file and the Rust probe checks its own rows against it in cargo test, so the two sides cannot drift apart. Type grammar: str, int, num, bool, obj, list<T>, enum:a|b; a trailing ? allows null. Unknown fields are errors. Every row carries v (schema version) and kind. A field with since N belongs to rows of version N and later: older rows stay valid without it, and a row of an older version may not carry it. Version 2 (2026-10-27) adds the node-time slot clock and its guard (plan section 5.1). Version 3 (2026-10-28) adds the leader correction of the aim and the first shreds from the final anchor to slot 2 (logs/aim-diagnosis-20261028.txt).

files.data/runs/<run_id>/probes.jsonl: written by probe: run, round, burst, probe, send, burst_end rows; probe rows are fsynced before the transaction leaves the machine
files.data/runs/<run_id>/collect.jsonl: written by collect: slot and inclusion rows
files.data/runs/<run_id>/blocks/<slot>.jsonl.g: written by collect: block_tx rows, one per transaction of an inclusion slot (competition inside the block)
files.data/runs/<run_id>/snapshots/: getClusterNodes, leader schedule and validators.app snapshots the labels come from
files.logs/<run_id>.jsonl: operational log: log rows, kept apart from the raw data
files.data/prereg-anchors.json: list of {stage, signature, file, manifest}: the Memo v2 transaction whose memo itb-prereg <sha256> anchors that file before the stage (plan section 10); manifest true when the file lists further files with their sha256

formats.endpoint: scheme://host[:port] only: no userinfo, path, query or fragment, because paid RPC URLs carry API keys there and raw data is published

run.doc: First row of every run. Section 11: mode and spend limit; section 8: everything the run needs to be re-read later.

run_id.doc: unique id, also the directory name

spend_limit_lamports.doc: effective limit: the code constant or a smaller --max-spend-lamports

code_limit_lamports.doc: the constant compiled into the probe (50 000 000)

rpc_url.doc: origin only; writers strip everything after host[:port]

wallet.doc: public key of the funding wallet; null in dry-run

payers.doc: the twelve payer addresses in payer_index order

round.doc: One per round of section 7: the random reference time and the snapshots the panel labels come from.

part.doc: quarter (0-3) or eighth (0-7) of the epoch

anchor_utc.doc: random reference time fixed before the round

burst.doc: Written and fsynced before the first probe of the burst is sent. Sections 4-8.

burst_seq.doc: global across all runs, recovered from data and chain on start

cell.doc: cell of the seeded table (arm x timing)

timing.doc: target arrival 300 ms before the window or at the start of its second slot

first_slot.doc: first slot of the target leader window

selection_class.doc: class the leader was selected under

leader_client_id.doc: clientId from getClusterNodes at the burst

tpu_quic.doc: ip:port from gossip at the burst

relayer_default_port.doc: tpuQuic on port 11228, the Jito relayer default (section 3)

fee_collector.doc: set when the leader's fee collector differs from its identity

equal_fee_lamports.doc: shared priority fee of the equal_fee and denominator arms

utc.doc: wall clock once per burst for the measurement log

slot_clock_basis.doc: node_ts: event times are the node timestamp of firstShredReceived plus clock_offset_ns, so a WebSocket backlog does not delay the clock; receipt: local receipt times

clock_offset_ns.doc: smallest local receipt minus node timestamp (ms * 1e6) over the last 1500 slots, the delivery of an event without backlog; null on the receipt basis

http_slot.doc: getSlot at processed commitment over HTTP right before this row; null when the call failed

clock_slot_at_http.doc: slot the clock gives for the midpoint of the call

clock_lag_slots.doc: http_slot minus clock_slot_at_http; the probe skips the burst at 2 or more and writes no row, analyze excludes it by the same bound (itb/prereg.py CLOCK_LAG_SKIP_SLOTS)

leader_correction_ns.doc: leader correction inside predicted_first_slot_ns and target_arrival_ns: median over this leader's earlier windows in the slot stream of the first window slot's node time minus its prediction from the window before (probe/src/slots.rs); 0 under the minimum number of windows

leader_correction_n.doc: windows of this leader the correction stands on; 0 when the slot before the window belongs to the same leader

slot_ms.doc: slot duration measured in this run

anchor_slot.doc: last slot the send moment was predicted from at signing; burst_end holds the final aim

predicted_first_slot_ns.doc: monotonic clock of the probe process

probe.doc: One per probe, fsynced before the probe is sent, so a crash never leaves an on-chain signature without a row (section 8).

worst_fee_lamports.doc: commitment booked in the spend journal before sending

tx_b64.doc: serialized signed transaction as sent; dry-run signs with the payers of the public dry-run wallet and sends nothing

send.doc: Outcome of sending one probe, appended after the send under the same signature (section 8).

code.doc: stream stop code or connection close code

send_end_ns.doc: monotonic end of write_all, lower bound of leaving the machine

stopped_ns.doc: monotonic moment stopped() resolved, upper bound

rpc_response.doc: sendTransaction response on the RPC path

burst_end.doc: Written after the last probe of a burst: connection statistics and the slot clock observations (sections 5.1, 6, 8).

quic_stats.doc: rtt_ns, lost_packets and other quinn path stats at burst end

first_shred_ns.doc: local monotonic receipt of firstShredReceived for slots 1 and 2 of the window

node_ts_ms.doc: timestamp field of the same events as reported by the RPC node

first_shred_node_ns.doc: the same events on node time: node_ts_ms * 1e6 plus clock_offset_ns, the local receipt they would have had without backlog

clock_offset_ns.doc: node time offset at burst end, as in the burst row

first_send_node_offset_ns.doc: first send minus first_shred_node_ns of slot 1; analyze takes it before first_send_offset_ns

first_send_offset_ns.doc: first send minus firstShredReceived of slot 1

prediction_residual_ns.doc: observed minus the final prediction (send_predicted_first_slot_ns) of the start of slot 1, observed on node time when known (version 2), else on receipt; zero when the final anchor is slot 1 itself; from version 3 the prediction holds the leader correction

send_anchor_slot.doc: freshest slot event the send moment was finally aimed from, about 2 ms before the send; null when nothing was sent

send_predicted_first_slot_ns.doc: start of slot 1 as finally predicted, leader correction included (version 3)

send_rtt_ns.doc: Connection::rtt() at the final aim; the send moment is the target minus half of it

leader_correction_ns.doc: leader correction inside the final prediction: as in the burst row while the final anchor lies before slot 1, else 0; null when nothing was sent

leader_correction_n.doc: windows the correction stands on, as in the burst row

shreds_from_slot.doc: first slot of shreds_node_ns: send_anchor_slot, at most 64 slots before slot 1 and at most slot 1; null when nothing was sent

shreds_node_ns.doc: firstShredReceived on node time of every slot from shreds_from_slot to slot 2 of the window, null for a slot without an event; kept for diagnosis of the aim, the analysis does not read it

slot.doc: One per slot that holds a probe and per first slot of each target window (crank memo). Section 8.

leader.doc: identity from the Fee reward record of the same block

ticks.doc: market-tick Increment V1 transactions: index, signer, timestamp_ns, interval_ns (target interval)

crank_memo.doc: memo of the tip-payment crank transaction, if present

inclusion.doc: Collector result for one probe signature. Section 8.

slot_in_window.doc: null when the probe landed outside the target window

actual_leader_class.doc: clientId of the actual leader from the burst's gossip snapshot

tick_segment.doc: index of the inter-tick segment the probe fell into

block_tx.doc: Inputs of the competition measure of section 10, one per transaction of an inclusion slot.

log.doc: Operational log (section 12). Never carries key material.
